content.title: NCAA Tournament: How to watch BYU face Texas in the round of 64
content.text: No. 6 seed BYU (23-11) vs. No. 11 seed Texas (19-14)Tip: Thursday, 5:25 p.m. MDTVenue: Moda Center, Portland, OregonTV: TBSRadio: 102.7 FM/1160 AMSeries: BYU leads 2-0 (most recent meeting: 2024)The trendsFor BYU: 15-11 record in Quad 1/2 games, No. 23 in KenPom, averaging 83.9 points scored and 75.3 points allowed per gameBest win of the season: 79-69 vs. No. 6 Iowa StateFor Texas: 7-13 record in Quad 1/2 games, No. 37 in KenPom, averaging 83.3 points scored and 76.5 points allowed per gameMost recent game: 68-66 win over NC State in NCAA Tournament First Four roundPlayers to watchBYU wing AJ Dybantsa: First Team All-American, leading the nation with 25.3 points per gameBYU point guard Rob Wright III: All-Big 12 Third Team selection, averaging 18.2 points and 4.7 assists per gameBYU guard Kennard Davis: averaging 13.8 points and shooting 43% from 3-point range across the past four gamesTexas guard Dailyn Swain: Second Team All-SEC selection, averaging 17.7 points, 7.6 rebounds and 3.4 assists per gameDailyn Swain is the best NBA prospect in this year's First Four of the NCAA Tournament, and he'll carry major influence if Texas works up any March magic.Long, versatile, instinctive, and has taken his offensive game to new heights this season in the SEC. Young for a junior. pic.twitter.com/9oBE4zJx33— Jacob Myers (@League_Him) March 16, 2026 Texas guard Tramon Mark: averaging 13.6 points per game, hit game-winning shot to defeat NC State in First FourTexas center Matas Vokietaitis: averaging 15.5 points and 6.9 rebounds per game while shooting 62% from the fieldPregame prepHere are a few stories to help get you ready for the NCAA Tournament
